title: research: bound A5 caller embedding into additive addresses
body:
## Summary

This adds a scoped caller-interface lemma for the completed two-register A5 word from PR #2246. A5 is perfect, so every homomorphism from its label group into an abelian source address group is trivial. In particular, mapping the A5 labels into the additive `M_3(Q)` caller model sends every group-algebra basis label to `[0]`; `diag([xy],[yx])` becomes the identity. Every action then has the same address-side trace. Cleanup can return the borrowed registers unchanged, but that restoration alone cannot supply the missing A5 action distinction.

The package does not repeat the A5 word search or claim a native supplier, a `kappa` improvement, or a universal impossibility result. It identifies the exact missing escape route: a nonabelian native carrier or another caller implementation that does not induce the specified group homomorphism.

## Evidence

- `python3 -I -B research/a5-abelian-caller-interface/verify.py` passes. It reconstructs A5, verifies the `(2,3,5)` target relations and distinct nonidentity order-five labels, checks the exact four-call positive word, and verifies the commutator proof of perfectness.
- `python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/a5-abelian-caller-interface --check-only` passes metadata and source-pin checks.
- `python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/a5-abelian-caller-interface --check-source-history` passes committed-byte and source-history checks.
- `python3 -B scripts/research_baseline.py` passes `PASS_RESEARCH_BASELINE_BINDINGS_ONLY`; the selected full replay and registered Python 3.12 replay were not run.

## Scope and credit

The A5 target, four-call word and finite lower bound come from 1337isnot1337's merged PR #2246. The additive caller contract comes from the cited three-register baseline. This package contributes only the caller-collapse proof and its focused verification. No independent human or proof-assistant review is claimed, and the selected frontier remains unchanged.

## Publication validation

`python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/a5-abelian-caller-interface` passed on CPython 3.12.3, and `python3.12 scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/a5-abelian-caller-interface --check-source-history` passed. The registered replay left the worktree clean. This supersedes any earlier pending note above for the registered package replay; separate full selected cold-replay limits remain as stated.
